notes: Cash basis, governmental funds only. Statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); the report's own receipt lines add 2 more than its printed total (report_discrepancies). General Fund budget 'Taxes' 12,641,216 split with the General Fund column of p4 (Property, Motor Vehicle, Other); Public Works 'Taxes' 244 = Other and Inheritance Fund 'Taxes' = Inheritance per p4. Health Services Bond Fund one-line Disbursements 921,449 split into principal/interest per its p4 column. Major-fund detail from the budget schedules (p5-7). The 27 nonmajor funds have one-line budget schedules (p8-11) and a combining statement (p12-15); detail uses the combining Total Nonmajor Funds column (p15, row labels on p12) as 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'; the one-line budget schedules are not recorded (no double counting). Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement (p3), whose totals equal the Statement of Net Position (p1); investments are inside the ending balance. Read pages 1-15 of 15
